subject: Priv Deployment - operator handoff & license carveouts (Order Form redline)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@orchid-health.com>, Procurement <procure@orchid-health.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 21, 2027 at 09:13 AM -0700
Subject: Priv Deployment - operator handoff & license carveouts (Order Form redline)

Hi Sara / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a redline of the Order Form (Orchid_Order_Form_v3_redlines.pdf) plus a short evidence matrix that maps typical audit asks to how Redwood can deliver them (evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx).

High-level ask from Orchid we need to resolve before legal sign-off: operator access, evidence delivery during audits, and the mechanism for establishing customer confidence in a private deployment (on-prem/VPC). We sketched two feasible approaches in the redline: a) Sealed snapshot deposit with third-party escrow (Redwood stores an encrypted snapshot and access is provided only on release conditions), or b) Scheduled witness handover (Redwood operator performs a witnessed snapshot in presence of customer-appointed witness).

Can you indicate which approach Orchid prefers (sealed deposit vs witnessed handover)? If you prefer sealed deposit, please confirm you are OK with a 6-month retention for nightly deposits and that the escrow provider can be one of the three vendor options we listed in the Annex. If you prefer witnessed handover, we need to agree an audit window cadence (we suggested 3 business days notice, 1 business day maximum window).

Two narrow points we need clarity on from your side so Legal can proceed with final redlines:
- Audit scope: confirmation whether Orchid needs continuous operator activity logs streamed, or whether recordings + consolidated logs delivered within 72 hours are sufficient.
- Operator credentials: do you require operator credentials to be shared directly, or is temporary scoped access (timeboxed via RDY tokens) acceptable?

Please review and flag the items you want reworded. If you want, I can set up a 30-min legal handshake next week to walk our respective counsels through the proposed language.

Attachments: Orchid_Order_Form_v3_redlines.pdf (redline), evidence_matrix_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
V: +1 415-555-0187

Subject: Re: Priv Deployment - operator handoff & license carveouts (Order Form redline)

Vivek —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick responses from our side: Orchid strongly prefers the sealed snapshot deposit approach provided the following are met:
- Escrow provider vetted (we can accept a list of 3 pre-approved providers)
- Retention capped (6 months acceptable) and a defined destruction process thereafter
- Access to operator activity logs within 72 hours of a formal request (we'll need an SLA for that)

On operator credentials: we do not want persistent operator credentials in our environment. Temporary, timeboxed access that is auditable is acceptable.

One additional ask from Procurement/Legal: we need a one-page forensic evidence checklist in the contract (we'll attach our standard request). I'll circulate Orchid_Audit_Reqs.pdf to Legal this afternoon.

If you can confirm the escrow candidate list and the 72-hour logs SLA, Procurement will move forward with internal approval and routing to Legal for signatures. Otherwise, we may need a brief Legal-only call.

Regards,
Sara Gomez
Head of Technical Procurement | Orchid Health
T: +1 312-555-4422

Attachments: Orchid_Audit_Reqs.pdf (provided to Legal)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, Apr 23, 2027 at 09:27 AM -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Priv Deployment - operator handoff & license carveouts (internal: proposed redline language)

Internal — quick alignment so I can respond to Orchid and give Procurement what they need for internal approval. Below are the precise snippets I propose our legal team push into the Order Form Annex. Please redline in-track and let me know if any of these are non-starters.

1) Sealed Snapshot Deposit (proposed clause):
"Upon Customer's execution of the Order Form, Redwood will generate and securely store an encrypted nightly snapshot of the licensed runtime ("Sealed Snapshot"). Redwood will deposit the Sealed Snapshot with an independent escrow agent approved by Customer. Access to the Sealed Snapshot will be granted to Customer only upon the occurrence of a Release Event as defined in the Annex; Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to provide Customer with operator activity logs within 72 hours of a written request following a Release Event."

2) Operator Access (proposed clause):
"Operator access to Customer environments will be temporary, timeboxed, and auditable. Redwood will provide scoped operator sessions that terminate automatically and will rotate credentials after each session. Persistent operator credentials shall not be provisioned in the Customer environment without Customer's express written approval."

3) Evidence Checklist (contract exhibit):
"Redwood will produce, upon request and subject to agreed confidentiality controls, the evidence items listed in Exhibit A (forensic checklist), which includes: compressed operator activity logs for the requested window, a integrity hash of the Sealed Snapshot, and a signed certificate of deposit from the escrow agent."

Operational asks for Engineering/Runbooks:
- Confirm we can deliver the 72-hour SLA reliably (David).
- Confirm the retention schedule (6 months) and auto-destruction flow (Marissa).
- Legal: Rachel, please sanity-check the clause language for liabilities/responsibilities tied to the escrow agent.

I'll reply to Sara with these proposed snippets and call out the escrow vendors we can support.

Thanks,
Vivek

From: Sara Gomez <sara@orchid-health.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procure@orchid-health.com>, Orchid Legal <legal@orchid-health.com>
Date: Wed, Apr 28, 2027 at 04:45 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: Priv Deployment - operator handoff & license carveouts (Order Form redline)

Vivek —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the precise clauses. Orchid Legal and Procurement reviewed the snippets and can accept the sealed snapshot + operator access language with two small edits:
1) In the Sealed Snapshot clause, we need the Annex to list the approved escrow providers by name (we accept the three vendors you proposed).
2) In the Evidence Checklist, please add that operator activity logs will include both command-level audit events and hash-verified file manifests.

Procurement is ready to proceed on the condition you: (a) confirm the three escrow vendors by name in your next message, and (b) confirm retention is 6 months with automatic secure deletion thereafter. Once you confirm, we'll route the attached DocuSign envelope for execution: https://app.docusign.com/link/0A1b2c3d4e5f6g

If Redwood prefers a Legal handshake, we can schedule a 30-minute call next Tuesday. Otherwise, Procurement will sign once we have the vendor names and retention confirmation.

Best,
Sara
